$comment: VALUEOS branding overlay — merged onto frontend/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json at BUILD TIME via `tauri build --config`. It renames the app to 'ValueOS Agent'. tauri.conf.json itself is never edited, so upstream merges stay conflict-free. Icons are applied separately by valueos/branding/apply-branding.sh. NOTE: app.windows is an ARRAY, and Tauri REPLACES arrays on merge (not element-wise) — so the full window object below mirrors upstream's values plus the new title. If upstream changes the window size/props, update this copy.
